# Privacy policy

Source: https://reground.pro/privacy
Summary: Reground collects no data. No account, no server, no analytics, everything you write, draw, or practice stays on your device.

Effective 8 July 2026 · applies to the Reground iOS app · need help with the app?

**The short version:** Reground collects no data about you. There is no account, no server, and no analytics. Everything you write, draw, or practice stays on your device. We couldn’t read your journal even if we wanted to, it never reaches us.

## What we collect

Nothing. Reground has no sign-up, no login, and no backend. The app never transmits your content, your usage, or your identity to us or to anyone else. We do not use analytics, advertising, or tracking of any kind, and the app contains no third-party SDKs.

## Where your content lives

Journal entries, thought records, drawings, session history, favorites, and settings are stored only in the app’s local storage on your device. They are included in your device backups if you use iCloud Backup or local backups (that is between you and Apple. We have no access). Deleting the app permanently deletes all of this content.

## Purchases

Reground offers one optional one-time purchase, processed entirely by Apple through your Apple ID. We never see your payment details, name, or address. Apple provides us with no personally identifying information about buyers. Purchases can be restored on any device signed into the same Apple ID, and refunds are handled by Apple under their standard terms.

## Health information

Anything you write in Reground may be sensitive to you. That is exactly why it never leaves your phone. Reground is a self-care toolkit, not medical care, and it does not diagnose, treat, or monitor any condition. If you are struggling, a mental-health professional can help in ways an app can’t.

## Children

Reground is not directed at children under 13, and since we collect no data from anyone, we collect no data from children.

## Changes to this policy

If Reground ever adds a feature that changes this picture (for example, optional iCloud sync), this policy will be updated first, the change will be opt-in, and the app will say so plainly. The current promise stands: by default, nothing leaves your phone.

## Support and contact

Questions, bugs, or anything about this policy? Write to [mmcydesign@gmail.com](mailto:mmcydesign@gmail.com) and it reaches Maksym Chervynskyi, who develops and publishes Reground. Purchases, receipts, and refunds are handled by Apple through your Apple ID; anything else, ask us.

# Terms of use

Source: https://reground.pro/terms
Summary: Terms of use for the Reground iOS app and reground.pro, in plain language: a self-care toolkit, a one-time purchase handled by Apple, and your content stays on your device.

Effective 6 November 2026 · applies to the Reground iOS app and reground.pro · [privacy policy](https://reground.pro/privacy)

**The short version:** Reground is a self-care toolkit, not medical care. You can use six techniques free, forever; one optional payment, handled by Apple, unlocks the rest. What you write stays on your device, which also means we can’t recover it for you.

## Who we are

Reground is developed and published by Maksym Chervynskyi, an independent developer. “We” on this page means the developer, reachable at [mmcydesign@gmail.com](mailto:mmcydesign@gmail.com).

## The app’s license

The Reground iOS app is licensed to you under Apple’s [Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/). These terms add a few plain-language points on top of it. If anything here conflicts with Apple’s agreement, Apple’s agreement governs the app.

## Not medical care

Reground offers calming and grounding techniques for everyday self-care. **It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or monitor any condition**, and it is not a substitute for a doctor, therapist, or emergency service. Some techniques carry their own cautions in the app; read them. Stop any exercise that makes you feel worse. If you are in crisis or might harm yourself, contact your local emergency number now.

## Purchases and refunds

The app is free to download. One optional one-time in-app purchase ($5.99 in the US; the local price is shown in the App Store) unlocks every technique, including techniques added later. It is not a subscription and never renews. Apple processes the payment through your Apple ID, so refunds go through Apple at [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com). A purchase can be restored on any device signed into the same Apple ID. Separate add-ons, if we ever make them, would be optional and would never take away what you already bought.

## Your content

Everything you write, draw, or record in Reground belongs to you and is stored only on your device. We never receive a copy, so we cannot restore it if the app is deleted or the device is lost. Your device backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup) are the only way to keep it.

## This website

The guides and comparisons on reground.pro are general information, not personal advice. Prices, ratings, and privacy labels of other apps come from their public App Store pages on the date each page states, and they change; check the listing before you rely on them. App names belong to their owners. If you spot something wrong, tell us and we’ll fix it.

## No guarantees

We work to keep Reground reliable and accurate, but the app and this site are provided as they are, without a promise of any particular result. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses that come from using them. Nothing on this page limits rights you have under the consumer law of your country.
